result.reason: The audit frequency, 30-day notice, business-hours limitation, independent confidentiality-bound auditor, and prohibition on systems access reach the preferred position. However, the cost-shifting trigger remains any “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than an underpayment exceeding 5%, so the operative language is broader than permitted. The cost paragraph was also unnecessarily moved ahead of subsection (b), reducing coherence and making the redline non-minimal.
